question.text: Length, breadth and thickness of a strip having a uniform cross section are measured to be 10.5 cm , 0.05 mm , and $6.0 \mu \mathrm{~m}$, respectively. Which of the following option(s) give(s) the volume of the strip in $\mathrm{cm}^3$ with correct significant figures:

solution.text:
$\mathrm{L}=10.5 \mathrm{~cm} \rightarrow 3$ significant digits
$\mathrm{b}=0.05 \mathrm{~cm} \rightarrow 1$ significant digit
$\mathrm{t}=6.0 \mu \mathrm{~m} \rightarrow 2$ significant digits
Volume, $\mathrm{V}=$ Lbt must have only 1 significant digit
$\begin{aligned}
& \Rightarrow \mathrm{V}=10.5 \times 0.05 \times 10^{-1} \times 6.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~cm}^3 \\
& =3 \times 10^{-5} \mathrm{cc}
\end{aligned}$
